paper.journal: International Journal of Coal Science & Technology
paper.title: Synthesis of activated carbon from Zhundong coal and its hydrogen storage application

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Tables 1-7 + methods): 7 unique samples (ZD-HK-AC in Table 4 == ZD-HK3-AC in Table 5, deduplicated), all 56 numeric cells confirmed. 303 K (Table 7), 80 bar; H-Sorb 2600T static volumetric. The 0.91 wt% headline (abstract/conclusion/Tables 4/5/7) used over the one-off Fig-4a '1.26'. Agent C accepted Agent B's decisive dispute: the calibration point is WITHHELD -- the paper states only 'calibrate the volume'/'sample volume calibration' + a leak check, with no He/blank/buoyancy/EOS/reference procedure, which is no stronger than HYC-0057 (withheld) and HYC-0015/0017 (scored 0). This drops the six acid-treated samples from Tier A to B, so all 7 rows are Tier B (code 7 for ZD-AC, 8 for the six with the HCl-demineralization purity point). Also accepted: ZD-AC and ZD-H-AC synthesis_method pyrolysis->carbonization (the paper's own 'directly carbonized' term; other+carbonization precedent, HYC-0021/0044); the 'alkali-carbon ratio' direction is undefined in the paper, recorded as labelled; pore_diameter_method=other. Purity point KEPT on the six acid-treated samples (5 M HCl demineralization of the raw coal + residual mineral content by XRF, Table 3; NOT the post-activation wash, excluded per HYC-0053/0057/0058). ZD-AC/ZD-H-AC classed 'other' (unactivated carbonized coal). M3 (ZD-HNa-AC) printed dp 2.66 nm vs 4V/A ~1.1 nm and a physically low Vtotal are source anomalies (S3.7): transcription matches Table 4, kept as printed with a note.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified. ALL at 303 K (Table 7), 80 bar. measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts (H-Sorb 2600T static volumetric; m1/m2 weigh = sample mass only).
notes.cal: calibration WITHHELD: the paper states only 'calibrate the volume' / 'sample volume calibration' + a leak check -- no He, empty-cell blank, buoyancy, EOS or reference material. Same wording as HYC-0057 (withheld) and HYC-0015/0017 (scored 0). All 7 Tier B.
notes.pur: purity point KEPT: 5 M HCl demineralization of the raw coal (Sec 2.2) with residual mineral content by XRF (Table 3) -> purification_method on acid-treated samples. ZD-AC (no acid) -> purity 0. (Table 3 is a stage series, not per-sample, so residual-metal fields are left empty.)
notes.tex: SBET by BET (ASAP-2460, N2/77K); Slang = langmuir; Smic = micropore_surface_area (t-plot); Vtotal @ P/P0 0.99 = total_pore_volume; Vmic (t-plot) = micropore_volume; Vmeso = Vtotal-Vmic = mesopore_volume; dp = average pore width of adsorption (pore_diameter_method=other). M3 (ZD-HNa-AC) anomaly: printed dp 2.66 nm vs 4V/A ~1.1 nm, and Vtotal 0.18 < BET monolayer equivalent -- transcription matches the table, kept as printed (S3.7).
notes.dup: ZD-HK-AC (Table 4) == ZD-HK3-AC (Table 5) -> recorded ONCE as ZD-HK3-AC.
notes.incon: the Fig-4a narrative says ZD-HK-AC '1.26 wt%' but the abstract, conclusion and Tables 4/5/7 all say 0.91 -> 0.91 used.
notes.ratio: 'alkali-carbon ratio' X (ZD-HK{X}-AC, X=1-4); the paper does not define the ratio direction (its 'excessive KOH' wording suggests KOH:coal = X:1), recorded as labelled.
